title: Churro Snack Mix
instructions: In a saucepan, melt 2 cups salted butter and 2 cups packed brown sugar and bring to a gentle boil. Take off the heat.
Add 2 tsp vanilla and 2 tsp cinnamon, then mix until combined.
Add in 2 bags of oyster crackers and mix until coated.
Spread the mixture onto a foil-lined baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.
While it bakes, mix together the coating ingredients: sugar, cinnamon, and salt.
While still warm (but not hot), transfer to a large bowl.
Sprinkle the cinnamon sugar mix over top and toss until every piece is coated.
notes: Recipe creator says: 'I love making this for every family event!' Recipe from her cookbook, more at https://krafftyskitchen.com/
